column1: EDPB/2026-11-11-coordinated-enforcement-2027-automated-decision-making-in-recruitment.md|||The EU's data protection regulators (EDPB) chose automated decision-making in recruitment, including AI candidate screening tools, as the topic of their 2027 coordinated enforcement action (announced 11 Nov 2026), focused on the GDPR right not to face solely automated decisions and the right of access; no start date beyond 2027 and participating authorities not yet named|||European Data Protection Board|||regulation, legal, ai screening, ai governance, ai transparency, eu
